headline: Data Quality Analyst

experience.title: Data Quality Analyst
experience.employer: Southern Leyte Data Processing Services Inc.
bullets: Write SQL checks that catch duplicate, incomplete and out-of-range records in health-insurance claims before they are sent to the client.
Verify a weekly sample of about 2,000 scanned claim forms against the encoded data and log each error by type.
Maintain the folder structure, naming rules and retention schedule for scanned documents.
Send team leads a weekly error summary and walk new encoders through the most common mistakes.

experience.title: Data Encoder
bullets: Encoded delivery receipts and supplier invoices, and reconciled stock counts with the warehouse every Friday.
Set up an Excel checklist that caught price mismatches between supplier invoices and purchase orders.

summary: Data quality analyst with three years in claims processing and retail back-office work. I write SQL checks, verify records against source documents and track error trends so teams can fix causes rather than symptoms. Comfortable with large volumes and strict turnaround times.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Information Systems
